name: Heaviside Step Derivative Approximation
definition: An approximation for the derivative of a Heaviside step function $H(g)$ that avoids extra back-propagation passes by using finite difference on intermediate values $g_+$ and $g_-$ computed during the forward pass of $H(g)$.
summary: Heaviside Step Derivative Approximation estimates gradients for step functions using forward-pass finite differences, offering O(1) efficiency unlike naive methods.
